# #387 — QMD-2: Triage and register the 55 unindexed Development repos (including _ob and _DOCS)

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: enhancement
Created: 2026-07-25T00:19:31Z
Updated: 2026-08-04T23:27:37Z

---

Parent: #342
Program: #320
Related: #386

## Problem

Only 27 of 82 directories under `/Volumes/ThunderBolt/Development` are
registered as qmd collections. 55 are invisible to the fast lookup path, so
agent sessions re-derive from raw files instead of querying the index.

The two most consequential absences:

- **`_ob`** — the canonical skill registry
- **`_DOCS`** — AGENT_WORKFLOW, MODEL_ROUTING, CODING_STANDARDS,
  REPO_BOOTSTRAP: the policy source of truth

Agents governed by those documents cannot fast-look-up the rules that govern
them. This is a plausible contributing mechanism for design drift across
autonomous sessions, though not proven as the cause.

Also missing: `mcp2cli` (a live Open Brain dependency), `rtech-mcps`,
`rtech-infra`, `rtech-agents`, `king-capital`, `skippy-agentspace`,
`bulkbridge`.

`open-brain` itself was absent until 2026-07-24 and has now been added
(521 files, embedded, search verified).

## Scope

This is triage, **not** a blanket add — indexing everything would bloat a
2.2 GB index with junk.

Exclude: `node_modules`, `_archive`, `_old`, `_tmp`, `tmp`, `outputs`,
`reports`, `_reports`, `fabric-outputs`, `*.git` mirrors, `_sandbox`.

Include (initial pass): `_ob`, `_DOCS`, `mcp2cli`, `rtech-mcps`, `rtech-infra`,
`rtech-agents`, `king-capital`, `skippy-agentspace`, `bulkbridge`, and the
remaining active project repos.

Record the exclusion rule somewhere durable so the next pass does not
re-litigate it.

## Verification

- A policy question answerable only from `_DOCS` returns the correct file via
  `qmd search`.
- A skill definition in `_ob` is retrievable by name.
- Index size growth is proportionate and no excluded path appears in results.
